''See also: [[Consume Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Consume [[technique]] is a [[hunger]]-based method used to absorb power, energy, and physical materials from various sources. It serves as a rapid shortcut for [[advancement]], allowing a practitioner to bypass the need for traditional resources by instead utilizing enemies. The [[technique]] is described as a straightforward application of [[hunger madra]] that functions much like a fire designed to burn through targets. It has diverse applications, ranging from draining [[madra]] and [[aura]] to devouring [[soulfire]], [[willpower]], Authority{{!}}authority, and even physical [[constructs]] or objects. When utilized, the [[technique]] can be highly addictive and may cause physical aftereffects or intense psychological urges to satisfy a growing [[hunger]]. Successful mastery of the [[technique]] can facilitate extremely rapid progression through ranks, such as moving toward [[Underlord]] or Overlord status. While the [[technique]] can be used to replenish one's own energy, it can also be used offensively to drain an opponent's power or even devour them from the inside. Beyond mere energy, consuming certain entities can also provide the user with their wisdom and experience.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Consume [[technique]] is a method used by [[Lindon]] that allows him to turn enemies into spiritual [[elixirs]] rather than relying on traditional [[advancement]] resources. [[Lindon]] identifies this [[technique]] as a way to feed [[Dross]] and hopes to successfully implement it to aid his development. Once integrated into his arm, the [[technique]] functions as a way for him to steal power from others. He eventually utilizes Consume to suck away the strength of the [[Remnant]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As a basic [[technique]], Consume was first utilized by [[Lindon]] at the beginning of his journey. This method is associated with [[Northstrider]] and can be employed to weaken a black dragon's breath{{!}}dragon's breath, such as when [[Lindon]] began consuming [[scales]] from a [[dragon]]'s lip. Beyond combat applications, the [[technique]] allows for the retrieval of memories from within a [[labyrinth]]. [[Lindon]] also used Consume to maintain his energy levels by absorbing the various attacks directed at him by enemies.}}
